source_segments.text: Empire Theatres ) supervised the alterations and when the theatre re-opened in 1884 , it was brought into the modern age with electric lighting , a skylight and even air-conditioning offering an entirely new level of sophistication .
New corridors , exits and dressing rooms greatly improved the theatre for audiences and performers alike as well as offering the required ( and vastly improved ) levels of ventilation and safety .
In 1888 , Wyndham took to the Criterion stage himself , with a run of 152 performances as famous thespian David Garrick .
